# magpie-gemini-web [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@dorokuma/magpie-gemini-web?style=flat-square&logo=npm&color=4f46e5)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dorokuma/magpie-gemini-web) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/@dorokuma/magpie-gemini-web?style=flat-square&color=06b6d4)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dorokuma/magpie-gemini-web) [![Magpie Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Magpie-Plugin-3b82f6?style=flat-square)](https://usemagpie.ai/) [![Node.js >= 22](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-8b5cf6?style=flat-square&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org/) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20Windows-6366f1?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/dorokuma/magpie-gemini-web) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-10b981?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [中文](README.md) | English Use **Google AI Studio** and **Gemini on the web** through your Google account in [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai/). The plugin runs [AIStudio2API](https://github.com/Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API) and [gemini-web2api-go](https://github.com/zexadev/gemini-web2api-go) locally, providing chat, native function calling, Nano Banana image generation, and Deep Research through OpenAI-compatible and Gemini APIs. > **New model support:** **Google AI Studio (`ai-studio`)** automatically follows official stable backend releases and supports **`gemini-4-hydrogen`** (including the `xhigh` thinking tier) and **`gemini-4-carbon`** (requires an eligible account tier such as Google AI Ultra). **Gemini Web (`gemini-web`)** is backed by [`dorokuma/gemini-web2api-go` `v6.2.0`](https://github.com/dorokuma/gemini-web2api-go/releases/tag/v6.2.0), which natively supports dedicated `gemini-4-carbon` / `gemini-4-hydrogen` / **`gemini-4-neon`** model IDs (including `-thinking` variants) and mutually recognizes slot upgrades/downgrades under `strict_model`; the `gemini-4-neon` family thinks server-side internally and never emits `reasoning_content`. **Chat and Task modes are separate:** use `gemini-4-neon` / `gemini-4-hydrogen` / `gemini-4-carbon` for everyday conversations (`gemini-4-carbon` and its `-thinking` / `-thinking-medium` variants are chat-only), and the dedicated **`gemini-4-neon-task`** / **`gemini-4-carbon-task`** / **`gemini-4-hydrogen-task`** models for task- and tool-heavy scenarios (they map to Gemini Web's Task mode). ## Fork Notice & Acknowledgements This project is an actively maintained **fork of [BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web)**, released under the original MIT license ([LICENSE](LICENSE)). Thanks to the original author [@bukowskiiiiii](https://github.com/bukowskiiiiii) and the upstream backend/ecosystem authors: - Gemini Web backend upstream: [zexadev/gemini-web2api-go](https://github.com/zexadev/gemini-web2api-go) (license: [LICENSE-UPSTREAM](LICENSE-UPSTREAM); the prebuilt binary pinned by this repo comes from the actively maintained fork [dorokuma/gemini-web2api-go](https://github.com/dorokuma/gemini-web2api-go)) - AI Studio backend: [Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API](https://github.com/Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API) - Host gateway: [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai/) **Key differences from upstream** (full history in [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)): 1. npm package renamed to the scoped **`@dorokuma/magpie-gemini-web`**; the original unscoped `magpie-gemini-web` remains maintained by the upstream author as an independent npm package. 2. The Gemini Web backend is pinned to the **official Release prebuilt binaries** of `dorokuma/gemini-web2api-go` (currently `v6.2.0`, SHA-256 synced one-way by script); the local patch-and-rebuild pipeline was retired. 3. Gemini Web adds `gemini-4-carbon` / `gemini-4-hydrogen` / `gemini-4-neon` model IDs (plus the dedicated task-mode models `gemini-4-neon-task` / `gemini-4-carbon-task` / `gemini-4-hydrogen-task`) with slot cross-validation; fixes include phantom session cleanup, AI Studio proxy precedence, and atomic publish/self-healing for update locks. ## Which Provider Should I Choose? The plugin provides two independent providers that can be used individually or together: | Feature | Google AI Studio (`ai-studio`) | Gemini Web (`gemini-web`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Best for** | **Primary use & coding agents (recommended)** | General chat & web quota | | **Key models** | `gemini-4-carbon` (Ultra / eligible accounts), `gemini-4-hydrogen`, `gemini-3.1-pro`, Flash series, Deep Research | `gemini-4-carbon` / `gemini-4-hydrogen` / `gemini-4-neon` (including `-thinking` variants; the Neon family thinks server-side internally and never emits `reasoning_content`), task-mode models `gemini-4-neon-task` / `gemini-4-carbon-task` / `gemini-4-hydrogen-task`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `gemini-3.6-flash`, `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`, `gemini-3.1-pro` | | **Tool calling** | **Native Function Calling**, reliable | Prompt-emulated (experimental; Flash often skips tools) | | **Thinking levels** | Supported levels from the model catalog: `minimal` / `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` (Hydrogen) | `low` (base) / `medium` (`-thinking-medium`, Carbon / Neon families) / `high` (`-thinking` extended thinking) | | **Image input** | On by default; chat models read images | On by default; chat models read images (needs a signed-in cookie) | | **Image generation** | Nano Banana models, for Magpie's image generation (Magpie v0.1.2075+, see below) | Not supported | | **Sign-in method** | Automatic official installation; confirm an imported account | Copy `cookie` from a private/incognito window | | **Usage cards** | Shows models currently on cooldown and recovery times | Syncs **5-hour** & **weekly** usage and reset times from the web | | **Local backend** | AIStudio2API (automatic installation and stable updates) | gemini-web2api-go (`v6.2.0` pinned binary) | --- ## Quick Start Install **@dorokuma/magpie-gemini-web** from the Magpie plugin market, then sign in to either (or both) providers below. By default, the plugin downloads the backend, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, and runs it in the background, with no Go installation required. > **Migrating from the legacy package:** since `0.15.0` the npm package is the scoped `@dorokuma/magpie-gemini-web` (previously the unscoped `magpie-gemini-web`). If you installed the old package, remove `magpie-gemini-web` from the Magpie plugin market and install the new one. The local data directory `~/.local/share/magpie-gemini-web`, saved Google accounts, cookies, database and credentials are all preserved—no sign-in or cookie re-import is needed. During the transition, uninstall cleanup recognizes both package names and never mistakes the new plugin for removed. AI Studio automatically follows official stable releases by default. You can disable automatic updates, select your own executable or connect an independent service. ### Option 1: Google AI Studio (`ai-studio`) 1. Sign in to **Google AI Studio** in Magpie and choose **「添加账号并连接（推荐）」** (Add an account and connect). 2. On first use, the plugin **automatically downloads, verifies and starts the latest stable official AIStudio2API backend**. No manual download, executable path, API key copying or administrator credentials are needed. 3. Click **「打开账号管理页」** (Open account management) on the connection page, then add a Google account using Chrome import, cookie import or browser login. 4. Return to the connection page, select the account and click **「连接到 Magpie」** (Connect to Magpie). The existing `ai-studio` provider, models, image generation and usage cards remain available. Repeat sign-in to add more accounts. If an existing account needs to sign in again, select that account in Magpie, use its **Re-login** action in account management, then return to confirm the connection. Subsequent starts reuse the installed executable. **Automatic stable updates are enabled by default:** while Magpie is running, the plugin checks in the background, caching successful release checks for an hour. After downloading and verifying an update, it waits for generation requests (including streams), account login and browser preparation to finish before upgrading and restarting. Accounts, port, credentials and settings remain in place; no new plugin release is needed. Failed checks or downloads leave the current version running. A failed new executable triggers an attempted rollback and blocks repeated attempts to install that archive. Use `npm run studio:updates -- manual` to manage versions yourself, or `npm run studio:updates -- auto` to resume automatic updates. Custom executables and independent services remain user-managed. Browser login downloads Camoufox (about 1.3 GB with v0.3.7+); Chrome / cookie import can use existing sessions. Magpie limits each connection attempt to 10 minutes. On slow connections, finish preparation in the official account management page: its background download and login tasks continue after Magpie times out. Then start a new connection in Magpie and select the imported account. Alternatively, run `npm run studio:prepare-browser` from the plugin directory before signing in. It waits up to an hour; closing the command does not cancel the backend download. Set `studio.proxy` or `AI_STUDIO_PROXY` if GitHub is unreachable. **「直接打开 Google 登录窗口」** still opens an isolated browser login window. Existing backends with Magpie task correlation can still complete the account connection automatically. Automatic installation supports macOS / Linux x64 and arm64, and Windows x64. macOS / Linux use official CLI archives. The official Windows archive contains a desktop executable, installed beside `.env` and `runtime/` in the data directory to retain its settings. Windows arm64 currently needs a compatible executable selected through the advanced path option (for example, an x64 executable supported by the system), or an independent backend. Unsupported targets receive guidance before a release lookup. **Existing installations and version selection:** - Accounts, port, credentials and Magpie cards are preserved. The plugin can also automatically replace an older `-magpie` build in the default directory with a newer official stable release. Its compiled updater restriction does not prevent this. Automatic replacement is deferred if an older backend lacks the APIs needed to confirm idle status. To switch immediately, quit Magpie, run these commands from the plugin directory, then reopen Magpie: ```bash npm run studio:stop npm run studio:install # Current official stable release npm run studio:start ``` - To choose an official version, stop the service and run `npm run studio:install -- --version v0.3.7`. This verifies the official SHA-256 and selects manual updates to preserve your choice. Run `npm run studio:updates -- auto` to follow stable releases again. Historical installation hashes do not force file restoration, and automatic updates never downgrade a newer running version. Back up the entire data directory before downgrading: older versions may not read data migrated by newer ones. - **Advanced option:** Select 「指定 AIStudio2API 程序路径（高级）」 (Specify executable path) or run `npm run studio:use -- "/absolute/path/to/aistudio2api"`. Use an executable extracted from an [official archive](https://github.com/Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API/releases), outside the plugin and AI Studio data directories; stop the old service before switching. A missing custom executable produces an error and is never replaced by a download. `studio:use-default` returns to the default directory, reusing its executable or installing the official CLI if absent. - Existing configurations receive a one-time migration of missing legacy defaults: `SEARCH_MODEL_ALIASES=false`, per-account concurrency / warm worker limit / maximum workers / warm startup concurrency all `1`, `ROUTING_STRATEGY=fill-first`, and `REQUEST_TIMEOUT=30m`, along with the earlier disabled hedging policy. Explicit settings and unknown keys remain intact. Later admin choices, including defaults omitted by upstream Save, are not seeded again. - Fresh installations follow upstream defaults. With v0.3.7+ this enables search model aliases, per-account concurrency 2, 10 warm / 20 maximum workers, round-robin routing, and SpiderMonkey generation. A future version changing the `WAA_BACKEND` default could also require Camoufox or other browser components for generation; choose explicit settings in the admin page if needed. - The plugin maintains the local connection and account access. Other settings belong to the backend, including future configuration keys. Uninstall or `studio:clean` removes downloaded programs from the default directory while retaining accounts and settings. With a custom path, the process, executable and entire data directory are preserved; use `studio:stop` to stop it. For an independently running service, choose **Connect an existing AIStudio2API (URL + API key)**. With official v0.3.7+, Hydrogen Extra High maps to Magpie's `xhigh` variant. ### Option 2: Gemini Web (`gemini-web`) 1. Sign in to **Gemini Web** in Magpie and choose **「一键配置本地 Gemini Web（推荐）」** (One-click local setup). If you need a proxy to reach Google, enter its URL (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:7890`) when prompted at the start of sign-in, or leave it blank for direct connection / existing proxy pool. 2. Enter the **Google account index** when prompted: for `/u/4/app` in the same window you copy cookies from, enter `4`; leave it blank for a single-account session (`0`). Private windows may assign different indices from your regular browser. Copy your cookie using a **private / incognito window** (Firefox recommended): 1. Open in the private window and sign in to your Google account. 2. Press `F12` (`⌥⌘I` on macOS), switch to the **Network** tab, and reload the page. 3. Click any `gemini.google.com` request → **Headers** → **Request Headers**, copy the `cookie` value, and paste it into Magpie. 4. **Close the private window directly—do not sign out** (signing out invalidates the cookie). 3. The plugin verifies the account and completes sign-in. Repeat the steps above to add more accounts. > **Backend upgrade required during sign-in?** An older background process may still be running. Exit Magpie, stop the matching `gemini-web2api-go` process (Windows: Task Manager → Details → `gemini-web2api-go.exe`), then run the full installation command shown in the error. It preserves accounts and configuration and selects the plugin's managed backend. Set `GEMINI_WEB_PROXY` first if the download needs a proxy. Reopen Magpie and sign in after installation. > **Why is a private window required?** The backend periodically refreshes this session to keep it alive. If it shares a session with your daily browser, Google will revoke the session and sign your browser out of all Google services. A private window (or a dedicated secondary Google account) gives the backend an isolated session. --- ## Multiple Accounts & Usage Cards - **Account usage cards:** Individual accounts use their email address. An AI Studio batch gets a separate group card; importing the same group in a different order keeps its identity. - *Migrating older Gemini Web accounts:* For accounts added in earlier versions, add a Gemini Web account in Magpie and choose **「添加本地后端里已有的 Google 账号」** (Add an existing Google account from the local backend) to create individual cards, then remove the old pooled `API key …` card. - **Automatic account rotation:** The local backend selects which Google account serves each request (Gemini Web rotates across the pool; AI Studio uses one account until cooldown and switches to the next, with optional account priority order and per-model account bindings configurable in the admin page or via `studio.accountOrder` and `studio.modelAccounts`). Switching cards in Magpie does not change which account the backend picks. - **Usage reporting:** - `gemini-web`: Available only with the one-click local backend. An AI Studio batch gets a separate group card; importing the same group in a different order keeps its identity. - *Migrating older Gemini Web accounts:* For accounts added in earlier versions, add a Gemini Web account in Magpie and choose **「添加本地后端里已有的 Google 账号」** (Add an existing Google account from the local backend) to create individual cards, then remove the old pooled `API key …` card. - **Automatic account rotation:** The local backend selects which Google account serves each request (Gemini Web rotates across the pool; AI Studio uses one account until cooldown and switches to the next, with optional account priority order and per-model account bindings configurable in the admin page or via `studio.accountOrder` and `studio.modelAccounts`). Switching cards in Magpie does not change which account the backend picks. - **Usage reporting:** - `gemini-web`: Available only with the one-click local backend. Usage is read from Google again whenever Magpie asks for it (at most once every 30 seconds per account), so pressing refresh shows the current allowance, including usage from the Gemini app, the website or other devices. On its own, Magpie asks about once a minute while the Usage page or the menu bar's allowances panel is open, whenever it updates allowances shown in the menu bar (every 3 minutes by default), and at most once a minute while it routes requests among accounts; otherwise it doesn't ask. A failed read isn't retried on its own for 10 minutes; pressing refresh in that time retries it at once (press it again if the first press doesn't). - `ai-studio`: AI Studio does not report remaining total quota; cards display models currently on cooldown and their recovery times, or prompt when re-authentication is needed. --- ## Image Generation (AI Studio) `ai-studio` lists the Nano Banana image models your account can use (such as `gemini-3.1-flash-image` and `gemini-3-pro-image`), for Magpie's image generation. **This needs Magpie v0.1.2075 or later**, the first to take a plugin's Gemini image models as models that draw. **Drawing from an agent** (pi, Claude Code, Codex and the rest alike): 1. **Pick the model to draw with:** Magpie's Settings list these models under **Images → Image generation**. Pick one (such as `ai-studio/gemini-nano-banana-2.1`), or leave it on Automatic. There's no need to tick them in any model list. 2. **Give the agent the drawing tool:** click **Give agents Magpie Image…** under that row, tick the agents that should draw in the Library it opens, then start a new session in the agent. With the Library turned off, the row says **Turn on the Library** instead: click that first. From the command line: `magpie library mcp add magpie-image magpie mcp image agents=pi` (several agents separated by commas, as in `agents=pi,claude`). 3. **Chat as usual:** keep the agent on its usual chat model and ask it to draw something. It calls the `generate_image` tool, which draws with the model from step 1 and saves the image in the project's `generated-images/` folder; reference images make it an edit. - **Don't pick an image model as the chat model:** Magpie still keeps a plugin's models that draw in its chat model lists ([yetone/magpie#2792](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/2792)). Picked there, they show no picture: an agent such as pi has no place for an image in the model's reply, so the image the model draws is dropped, while the model believes it was shown. They take no tool calls either, and have 32K–128K context windows. - **Drawing from the command line:** `magpie tool generate_image "a magpie on a branch, watercolour" --size 16:9 -o magpie.png`; add `--model ai-studio/gemini-3-pro-image` to draw with another model this once. # 后端发布与同步

从 `0.15.0` 起，Gemini Web 后端采用**一仓一制品**：插件直接使用 [`dorokuma/gemini-web2api-go`](https://github.com/dorokuma/gemini-web2api-go) 官方 Release 发布的预编译二进制，插件仓不再保留补丁与本地重编流水线（`patches/argon.patch`、`scripts/backend-release.mjs`、`scripts/backend-argon.mjs` 已退役）。`lib/backend-release.json` 是唯一 pin 清单，记录 `version`、`repository`、`tag` 与 6 个平台资产的文件名和 SHA-256。

## pin 的结构与约束

- `version` 为严格单行 SemVer（如 `5.0.0`），`tag` 必须等于 `v${version}`，`repository` 固定为 `dorokuma/gemini-web2api-go`。
- `binaries` 恰好包含 6 个平台键：`darwin-arm64`、`darwin-x64`、`linux-x64`、`linux-arm64`、`win32-x64`、`win32-arm64`；资产名为 `gemini-web2api-go_v${version}_${goos}_${goarch}${ext}`（Windows 为 `.exe`），哈希为 64 位小写十六进制。
- 任何平台的哈希不得与 `lib/native.mjs` 中 `UPSTREAM_BINARIES`（上游 `zexadev/gemini-web2api-go` `v4.28.0` 回滚通道）重复，避免通道混淆。
- **禁止手改 SHA-256**；pins 只能由同步脚本生成。

## 同步新后端版本（write-pins）

后端仓发布新 Release（含 6 平台二进制与 `SHA256SUMS.txt`）后：

```bash
node scripts/sync-backend-pins.mjs --write-pins --tag=vX.Y.Z
# 或
npm run backend:pins:sync -- --tag=vX.Y.Z
```

脚本会：

1. 校验 `--tag` 为严格单行 `vX.Y.Z`；
2. 拉取 `https://github.com/dorokuma/gemini-web2api-go/releases/download/vX.Y.Z/SHA256SUMS.txt`；
3. 解析并校验 6 个平台齐全、无重复、资产名精确匹配、哈希为 64 位小写十六进制；
4. 构造清单并再次校验后**原子写入** `lib/backend-release.json`（2 空格缩进 + 末尾换行）。

## 校验（verify / verify-schema）

```bash
node scripts/sync-backend-pins.mjs --verify-schema   # 纯离线：校验清单结构
node scripts/sync-backend-pins.mjs --verify          # 离线校验 + 联网比对
# 或 npm run backend:pins:verify
```

`--verify` 先做离线结构校验，再拉取已发布 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 逐平台比对哈希完全一致，并对全部 6 个资产 URL 发 `HEAD`（必要时回退 `Range: bytes=0-0`）确认可达。CI 的 `plugin` 作业额外用 Go `1.27.1` 从 pin 的源码 tag 重建 `linux-x64` 并比对 SHA-256，提供源码↔二进制可复现溯源。

## 冒烟（backend-smoke）

```bash
node scripts/backend-smoke.mjs --download           # 从 pin 的 Release URL 下载真实二进制
node scripts/backend-smoke.mjs --binary=/path/bin   # 冒烟本地二进制（仍校验 pin 哈希）
# 或 npm run backend:smoke
```

冒烟使用独立临时数据目录与黑洞代理，验证安装、SHA-256、`GET /` 的 `health.version === release.version`、`capabilities.account_proxy_binding === true`、认证、模型列表、双代理池首检绑定以及已验证二进制的复用；不使用 Google 账号。解包 tarball 后可直接运行 `package/scripts/backend-smoke.mjs --download`。

## 回退（upstream 通道）

`lib/native.mjs` 保留上游 `zexadev/gemini-web2api-go` `v4.28.0` 的 6 平台 pin 作为**显式校验回滚通道**：

```bash
npm run backend:install:upstream   # 回退并固定官方 v4.28.0
npm run backend:install            # 恢复默认（pin 的 dorokuma Release）
```

选择持久化在数据目录 `backend-channel.json`；自动启动按所选通道校验哈希。历史本机 Argon 构建的 `argon-build.json` 记录继续被信任与清理，但不再产生新的本地构建。

## 首次发布 npm 包

`@dorokuma/magpie-gemini-web` 首次发布到 npm 必须提供 `NPM_TOKEN` secret（npm Trusted Publishing OIDC 仅支持已存在包的后续版本，工作流会在未配置 token 且包尚不存在时直接报错）。

## 官方安装与版本管理

`lib/studio-upstream.mjs` 从 GitHub Releases API 解析 latest，或 `studio:install -- --version <tag>` 指定的标签；只选择 macOS / Linux x64、arm64 和 Windows x64 对应的官方归档。安装器要求官方仓库的下载 URL 和有效的 `sha256:` digest，校验归档后解压；元数据缺失、哈希不符或不安全归档会中止，保留原程序。发布信息查询和下载均使用已有代理设置。`--archive` 可复用本地官方包，但仍需查询所选版本的官方校验值。CI 通过 `AI_STUDIO_GITHUB_TOKEN` 提供 GitHub 的短期只读凭据，减少共享 runner 的匿名 API 限额影响；它仅用于发布元数据查询，经 curl 标准输入传递，不写入配置、不用于安装包下载认证，也不传给后端。普通用户无需设置该变量。

默认程序保存在数据目录的 `package/aistudio2api`；Windows 官方包属于桌面版，会自行切换工作目录，因此默认把 `aistudio2api.exe` 放在数据目录根部，与 `.env` 和 `runtime/` 相邻。启动先复用已有程序，缺失时下载。`install-manifest.json` 记录来源与完整性校验，不强制恢复历史文件或版本。

`lib/studio-updates.mjs` 在 Magpie 运行期间后台检查官方稳定版：启动一秒后首次尝试，每分钟寻找空闲窗口；成功检查缓存一小时，联网／下载失败后等待 15 分钟重试。只有可解析、较新的稳定版本可以自动安装，未知开发版本和已安装的较新版本不被降级。默认目录自动启用；`studio:updates auto|manual` 修改策略，`studio:install -- --version <tag>` 切到手动更新。高级自备路径和独立服务不参加自动更新。

生成请求的占用持续到响应体读完、取消或中止，流式响应不会在收到响应头后提前释放；登录占用覆盖整个连接回调。进程启动时间和随机标识支持跨宿主协调，失效记录只删除对应的独立文件，避免清理旧锁时误删新锁。更新还检查后台生成计数、忙碌账号、未结束登录任务、浏览器下载／准备和官方更新器状态；能力缺失或状态未知时暂缓。

下载、官方 SHA-256 校验和解压先在暂存目录完成，原服务继续可用。替换前取得维护锁，再检查任务、策略和现有程序哈希；仅在进程身份确认并退出后交换程序，启动新版本并核对报告的版本。失败时尝试恢复并启动旧程序，该发行包随后不再反复触发重启；重新启用自动更新可明确重试。账号、`.env`、配置、端口和凭据原样保留。回滚覆盖程序文件和安装记录，不撤销上游自身的数据迁移。

已有无 `backend` 字段的配置沿用默认目录。具备所需管理接口的旧 `-magpie` 构建也可由插件自动替换为较新的官方包，无需调用其受限的在线更新接口。显式安装、程序切换、启动与自动更新共享生命周期锁；HTTP 暂时关闭但旧进程仍存活时，阻止重复启动或覆盖。需要手动切换时仍可停止服务后执行 `studio:install`。

本地连接所需的监听地址、绝对账号目录 `AISTUDIO_AUTH_STATES`、API key、管理员认证和自动启动由插件维护。新建 `config.json` 标记 `defaultsPolicy: upstream`，其余设置采用官方默认值。已有配置没有该标记时，只为缺失项写入旧默认值，成功后标记 `legacy-migrated`：搜索模型别名关闭，`PER_ACCOUNT_CONCURRENCY`、`WARM_WORKER_LIMIT`、`MAX_ACTIVE_WORKERS`、`WARM_STARTUP_CONCURRENCY` 均为 1，路由为 `fill-first`，请求期限为 30 分钟；同时保留旧版关闭备用请求、非流式保活及生成后端的默认行为。所有显式值及合法未知键保留。迁移只执行一次，避免官方 Save 省略其默认值后又被插件反复补写。

新安装目前采用官方 SpiderMonkey 生成默认值；如果以后选用的版本改变 `WAA_BACKEND` 默认值，生成也可能需要 Camoufox 等浏览器依赖。并发和路由同样跟随所选版本，v0.3.7 为每账号并发 2、预热 10／最大 20 个 Worker 和 round-robin。宿主同名配置变量仍被隔离；`.env` 首行注释避免官方后端误触旧版完整文件迁移。

## 插件账号管理接入

默认官方包没有 `magpie_signin` 能力，`lib/studio-connect.mjs` 会进入 `lib/studio-connect-legacy.mjs`：用户打开已认证的官方管理页添加账号，再回到连接页选择并确认。过期账号会明确提示找到原账号并点击「重新登录」，确认仍限定为原账号。页面在断线时停用确认按钮，恢复后清除临时错误；弹窗拦截重试成功后清除旧提示，迟到响应不会覆盖取消结果。推荐入口改名为「添加账号并连接（推荐）」，直接说明添加后回程确认。凭据由插件生成并接入管理会话，无需填写 URL、API key 或管理员密码；额度卡片不展示管理员信息、凭据位置或程序路径。Magpie 宿主仍有 10 分钟等待上限，官方管理页的后台准备和登录不受该连接超时影响；新增 `studio:prepare-browser` 可在登录前独立准备 Camoufox，不再占用登录计时。原有 `metadata.managed: true` 表示本地生命周期与账号接入，独立于后端版本；已有单账号、账号组卡片和模型功能继续可用。

下面保留任务关联补丁的技术说明。对提供 `magpie_signin: 1` 的旧版或自定义后端，插件继续使用自动完成流程；这不是默认官方安装的前置条件。

提供任务关联能力时，`lib/studio-connect.mjs` 在准备本地服务后，同一标签页自动进入该后端的账号导入／登录界面。上游登录模式展示 Chrome 导入、Cookie 导入、调试浏览器会话导入和浏览器登录，隐藏远程配对。专用重登入口显示加载、错误或账号缺失状态，使用隔离浏览器重新登录。v0.3.5 也支持通过添加账号入口导入同一账号来更新认证状态；`studio-0.3.5-signin-reauth.patch` 修正此前不支持覆盖导入的提示。单个账号成功后直接保存原有 `managed: true` 的 `ai-studio` 登录；批量导入成功后保存 `metadata.accounts` 和带账号集合摘要的 `metadata.email`，使不同分组不会互相覆盖；同组以不同顺序重试保持相同标识。额度卡片的账号和冷却记录都按本次账号组过滤。此元数据不改变后端的全局选号、API key 绑定或模型绑定规则。模型、图片和用量继续走原插件，不调用 `magpie://import` 创建其他供应商。

`patches/studio-0.3.4-magpie-signin.patch` 给管理页增加由 URL fragment 开启的登录模式，并给账号任务增加 `client_id`、成功条目的规范 `account_id` 和 `GET /api/accounts/tasks` 的 `magpie_signin: 1` 能力标识。每次登录使用独立随机标识；只有当前页面提交的完整成功任务能完成认证。插件从后台任务取得账号 ID，再重新读取账号列表校验。已有账号、其他窗口任务、失败或部分失败任务均不会自动完成当前登录。部分失败可只重试失败账号：插件按本次标识累积每个已成功条目的账号 ID，最终成功时合并、去重并重新校验。登录模式暂不提供关闭失败任务的按钮，避免插件观察前删除成功条目；已观察到的成功条目即使之后从任务列表移除也会保留。刷新页面保留登录标识；关闭浏览器后，插件仍能跟踪已启动任务。

**历史构建：** `0.3.5-magpie.1` 和候选 `0.3.7-magpie.1` 均含自动登录补丁。插件按能力标识选择流程，官方或其他构建缺少该能力时手动确认账号。

## 高级程序路径与验收

「指定 AIStudio2API 程序路径（高级）」和 `studio:use -- <executable>` 共用 `useStudioBinary()`，保存 `backend: { "mode": "user", "binaryPath": "/absolute/path/to/aistudio2api" }`。程序须位于插件和 AI Studio 数据目录之外。插件不复制或下载替换该文件，缺失时直接报错。`studio:use-default` 在停止服务后回到默认目录，保留原自备程序；默认目录的已有程序继续复用。

两种启动模式均传入绝对账号目录环境变量和 `-auth=...` 标记；自备程序的进程归属同时核对该标记和可执行文件，防止误停共用程序的其他实例。检测保留 true／false／unknown 三种结果，无法确认存活进程身份时保留 PID、阻止启动与替换且不发送信号。启动记录另存进程启动时间、程序路径和账号目录，只在 PID 与这些记录仍相符时恢复暂时不可读的命令行归属。macOS 扫描同时读取 comm 和完整启动命令，识别 CLI 更新器的隐藏旧文件及 deleted 标记。两种本地路径均保留认证、状态结构和 API key 检查，不按版本字符串判断服务归属。
